posts.title: Self-calling executables
posts.description: I call the "self-calling executable" an inception technique, by which a currently running executable starts another version of itself (directly or indirectly). This technique can be quite useful in testing scenarios as well as in command-line tools (such as TUIs). posts.title: Software patches in NixOS for fun and productivity
posts.description: After using NixOS for more than a year, one aspect that I didn't expect to enjoy was software patching. In previous systems, my patches usually became stale (since I never manually pulled the latest release to re-apply my patch).
